open.label: Open price
open.description: Price of the latest completed candle in the selected timeframe. Offset 1 selects the candle before it.

high.label: High price
high.description: Price of the latest completed candle in the selected timeframe. Offset 1 selects the candle before it.

low.label: Low price
low.description: Price of the latest completed candle in the selected timeframe. Offset 1 selects the candle before it.

close.label: Close price
close.description: Price of the latest completed candle in the selected timeframe. Offset 1 selects the candle before it.

volume.label: Volume
volume.description: Traded shares in the completed candle.

ema.label: EMA
ema.description: EMA calculated on completed candles. Period counts candles of the selected timeframe.

sma.label: SMA
sma.description: SMA calculated on completed candles. Period counts candles of the selected timeframe.

rsi.label: RSI
rsi.description: RSI calculated on completed candles. Period counts candles of the selected timeframe.

atr.label: ATR
atr.description: ATR calculated on completed candles. Period counts candles of the selected timeframe.

avgVolume.label: Average volume
avgVolume.description: Average of the preceding N candles, excluding the candle being evaluated.

highestHigh.label: Highest high
highestHigh.description: Rolling extreme over N completed candles including the evaluated candle. Use offset 1 to exclude it for breakout comparisons.

lowestLow.label: Lowest low
lowestLow.description: Rolling extreme over N completed candles including the evaluated candle. Use offset 1 to exclude it for breakout comparisons.

bodyAboveEma.label: Candle body above EMA
bodyAboveEma.description: Percentage of the open-to-close body above the EMA calculated at that candle close. Wicks are excluded. Zero-size bodies are unavailable. Period is the EMA length.

bodyBelowEma.label: Candle body below EMA
bodyBelowEma.description: Percentage of the open-to-close body below the EMA calculated at that candle close. Wicks are excluded. Zero-size bodies are unavailable. Period is the EMA length.

bodyPercent.label: Candle body / range
bodyPercent.description: Absolute open-to-close body divided by high-low range, times 100. A zero-range candle is unavailable.

ema5.label: EMA 5
ema5.description: Fixed-period legacy indicator; use the configurable EMA or SMA for other periods.

ema20.label: EMA 20
ema20.description: Fixed-period legacy indicator; use the configurable EMA or SMA for other periods.

ema21.label: EMA 21
ema21.description: Fixed-period legacy indicator; use the configurable EMA or SMA for other periods.

ema50.label: EMA 50
ema50.description: Fixed-period legacy indicator; use the configurable EMA or SMA for other periods.

sma50.label: SMA 50
sma50.description: Fixed-period legacy indicator; use the configurable EMA or SMA for other periods.

sma200.label: SMA 200
sma200.description: Fixed-period legacy indicator; use the configurable EMA or SMA for other periods.

avgVolume20.label: 20-candle average volume
avgVolume20.description: Average volume of the preceding completed candles, excluding the evaluated candle.

avgVolume6.label: 6-candle average volume
avgVolume6.description: Average volume of the preceding completed candles, excluding the evaluated candle.

rvol.label: Relative volume
rvol.description: Completed-candle volume divided by the preceding N candles mean volume. Not a same-time-of-day comparison.

volumeRatio.label: Volume ratio
volumeRatio.description: Completed-candle volume divided by the preceding N candles mean volume. Not a same-time-of-day comparison.

macd.label: MACD (12,26)
macd.description: Fixed 12/26 EMA MACD; signal uses a 9-period EMA.

macdSignal.label: MACD signal (12,26,9)
macdSignal.description: Fixed 12/26 EMA MACD; signal uses a 9-period EMA.

bollingerUpper.label: Bollinger upper band
bollingerUpper.description: Middle SMA(period) plus 2 standard deviations of completed-candle closes. Period counts candles of the selected timeframe.

bollingerLower.label: Bollinger lower band
bollingerLower.description: Middle SMA(period) minus 2 standard deviations of completed-candle closes. Period counts candles of the selected timeframe.

bollingerBandwidth.label: Bollinger bandwidth
bollingerBandwidth.description: Upper band minus lower band, as a percentage of the middle band. Falling values indicate a volatility squeeze.

adx.label: ADX
adx.description: Wilder's Average Directional Index. Measures trend strength regardless of direction, from 0 to 100. Period counts candles of the selected timeframe.

diPlus.label: +DI (ADX)
diPlus.description: Positive directional indicator from the ADX system. Compare against -DI to judge trend direction; use with ADX for trend strength.

diMinus.label: -DI (ADX)
diMinus.description: Negative directional indicator from the ADX system. Compare against +DI to judge trend direction; use with ADX for trend strength.

supertrend.label: Supertrend (10, 3x ATR)
supertrend.description: Trend-following stop line using a fixed 10-period ATR and 3x multiplier. Price crossing this line is the classic Supertrend buy/sell signal.

doji.label: Doji candle
doji.description: 1 when the candle's body is 5% or less of its high-low range, 0 otherwise.

hammer.label: Hammer candle
hammer.description: 1 when the candle has a small body near the top of its range with a lower wick at least twice the body and little to no upper wick, 0 otherwise. Shape only; trend context is not checked.

bullishEngulfing.label: Bullish engulfing
bullishEngulfing.description: 1 when a bullish candle's body fully engulfs the prior bearish candle's body, 0 otherwise.

bearishEngulfing.label: Bearish engulfing
bearishEngulfing.description: 1 when a bearish candle's body fully engulfs the prior bullish candle's body, 0 otherwise.

accDist.label: Accumulation/Distribution line
accDist.description: Cumulative volume-weighted line combining each candle's close position within its range with volume. Rising values indicate accumulation (buying pressure); falling values indicate distribution.

vwap.label: VWAP
vwap.description: Session VWAP estimate from completed bars using typical price and volume. Resets each trading session.

priceChange.label: Price change
priceChange.description: Percentage change from the previous completed candle close.

high52w.label: 52-week high
high52w.description: Daily-price extreme across the preceding 364 calendar days as of the selected completed day/month. Requires a full year of history, not 52 candles.

low52w.label: 52-week low
low52w.description: Daily-price extreme across the preceding 364 calendar days as of the selected completed day/month. Requires a full year of history, not 52 candles.

marketCap.label: Market cap
marketCap.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

debtEquity.label: Debt / equity
debtEquity.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

roe.label: Return on equity
roe.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

roce.label: Return on capital employed
roce.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

pe.label: P/E
pe.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

pledge.label: Promoter pledge
pledge.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

promoterHolding.label: Promoter holding
promoterHolding.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

fiiChange.label: FII holding change
fiiChange.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

diiChange.label: DII holding change
diiChange.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

delivery.label: Monthly delivery percentage
delivery.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

tradedValue.label: Monthly traded value
tradedValue.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

turnover.label: Monthly average daily turnover
turnover.description: Average daily turnover across all sessions in a verified completed month (INR crore), NOT the last completed day turnover. Existing saved rules retain this meaning.

sector.label: Sector
sector.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

index.label: Index membership
index.description: Dated reported observation. Missing or expired reports remain unavailable.

dailyTurnover.label: Completed-day turnover
dailyTurnover.description: Actual exchange turnover in INR crore for the latest completed daily candle. Requires its dated exchange report; never estimated as price times volume. Reports published after the close cannot trigger a same-close signal. For yesterday during an intraday session use offset 0; for the session before the evaluated daily candle use offset 1.

avgDailyTurnover.label: Average daily turnover (N sessions)
avgDailyTurnover.description: Mean actual exchange turnover over N completed sessions including the latest closed session. Every session needs a report.
